print("dangling refs",bad)

    t=rows[v['n']]['text']
    vals=re.findall(r'=\$?("[^"]*"|[^ \n]+)',s)
    toks=[]
    for x in vals:
        x=x.strip('"').lower()
        if x.startswith('$'): continue
        toks.extend(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9:>\-'’\.]+",x))
    tw=[w for w in words(t) if w not in ('.',',',':',';','?','!','-','>','->')]

    missing=[w for w in c2 if c1[w]<c2[w] and w not in ('n\'t',)]
    extra=[w for w in c1 if c1[w]>c2[w]]
    if missing or extra:
        print("COVER n",v['n'],"missing",missing[:8],"extra",extra[:8])

What drove the rejections:

| Kind | Rows | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | 39, 60, 62, 99, 150, 260, 278, 285, 291, 297, 314, 317 | form of a clause wrong (statement as `interrogative`, reported question as `interrogative`), a noun made the verb ("Family", "meeting", "Hiring"), a command held as a fragment ("colour it gold", "block 3 hours"), main verb demoted to auxiliary ("Hannah needs adding") |
